trainer/30851.htm.text: Master Kendra: The rumors that the Tower of Insolence has collapsed are apparently true! Now there's a mad rush for relics from that place. Be warned, though: that is an exceedingly dangerous place, perhaps now more than ever. If you are careless, that tower will become your tomb...

trainer/30851-noteach.htm.text: Master Kendra: All my time is taken teaching Human warriors. You should find a master more suited to your needs.

Q00337_AudienceWithTheLandDragon/30851-0.text: Master Kendra: Please come in! I trush Gabrielle's judgement but still I'd like to test you myself. I don't want the responsibility of a needless death on my conscience. If you wish to receive my Mark of Watchman, go to the Forest of Mirrors and kill Harit Lizardman matriarchs and shamans and bring…

Master Kendra: Yes, this is proof, all right! Here is my Mark of Watchman. Once you obtain the marks from the other guardians, you will be qualified to confront Antharas. Unfortunately qualifying does not assure success in your mission. I fear that your reckless behavior and ignorance will be the e…
Master Kendra: You still must meet other guardians... Your skills will serve you well with them... What comes after is another matter...

Master Kendra: One by one, brave warriors prepare to throw themselves into the jaws of the beast... Oh well, the sooner you get started the better your chances will be. But... Gabrielle is looking for all those who hold the marks of watchman! Something must have happened!

links.text: Ask about the Agathion in charge of skill enchantment.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
